translate_en|mods/TraitsExtended/42/medi:
Lift with the back, never the knees. The ultimate mule.
Carry capacity +50% for every point of Strength.

Every step takes its toll.
Leg pain builds the more you walk each day, easing overnight.

Something in there isn't right.
A mild jolt of pain hits roughly every 3 hours.

Built like an ox. Your bones simply do not give.
Bones never fracture or sprain.

It never fully healed.
Pain that worsens over time and prevents sleep unless you keep painkillers in your system. Carry capacity -35%.

You've seen things inside. The dead don't scare you.
Never panics (no fear).

Your body offers no defense against the virus.
Any scratch, cut or laceration has a 50% chance to infect you on the spot.

Your nerves are dead to the world.
You feel no pain and never suffer muscle fatigue.

Gumming your food is slow work.
Eating takes twice as long.
